reviewScope: Internal engineering/model-consistency and browser viewport review, not independent expert, official-board, real-ink calibration or physical-device certification. Chosen capillary square-root law and equal phase-volume distribution ratios; instantaneous mobilisation at origin wetting. Truncated normalised Gaussian bands with prescribed broadening; peak/mode rather than truncated centroid defines migration. No gravity, evaporation, pool depletion or full transport/adsorption PDE. Colours and transverse shape illustrative; nominal Gaussian resolution does not certify purity. Pointer orbit/FPS/physical printing not certified.
